en: Hanna Rochereau (b. 1995) is a French artist based in Marseille. Her painting and installation practice is rooted in an observation of the spaces, tactics and gestures associated with the commodification of desire. Focusing on staging and display, she observes how temptation, frustration and absence circulate and materialize. The showcase or storage, the archive or packaging then serve as starting points for a formal questioning of the affects crystallized by certain objects.
Involved in Marseille’s contemporary art scene since 2020, she has been a resident at Ateliers de la Ville de Marseille.

Among other projects, she has been invited to take part in residencies at Ateliers de la Ville de Marseille, La Becque and Villa Belleville. And to exhibit at Tonus (Paris), La Friche Belle de Mai(Triangle Astérides, Marseille), La Traverse (Marseille), Palazzina (Basel), The Community (Paris), Lokal-int (Biel), 13 Vitrine (Lausanne), Sentiment (Zurich), Sic Gallery (Helsinki), Suns.works(Zurich), Lo Brutto Stahl (Paris), Astor weeks (New York), Shmorevaz (Paris) Hauser &Wirth (Paris), Paulina Caspari (Munich)
